rules.message: The snapshot keys must live outside the swap target — a page swap inside .hc-datagrid__body would destroy the snapshot.
keys is the snapshot membership and is always hidden inputs — row selection is a different list (name="ids", checkboxes).
Pager entries are submit buttons with name="page" and data-hx-post — the snapshot travels in the POST body, so links can't carry it.
Pager buttons must swap innerHTML — replacing the tbody itself (outerHTML) detaches the element the grid observes.
The form needs method="post" and an action so the pager buttons work without JavaScript.
The no-JS fallback must POST — a GET pager would put the whole snapshot in the URL.
Give the status line aria-live="polite" so page changes and processing progress announce.
